decision_reason: The existing exact Q4T16 c1 dual+SiLU owner is the only retained gfx1151 0.8B optimization with both a matching 27B operation and a matching sole-resident layout. It removes 128 PM4 graph nodes, improves Qwen3.8 graph decode 1.259% and full-suite true AR 13.364%, leaves prefill and memory non-regressive, and improves absolute native-B3 throughput with unchanged acceptance and exact outputs.

implementation.fallback: two registered dense_single_local32 Q4T16 projections plus separate BF16 SiLU
implementation.routing: geometry policy with legacy name-key fallback for existing narrow-model policies; no backend or quant branch in runtime

gfx1151_08b_transfer_audit.package: P1/P6 compact Q5T16 QKV and SSM-out
gfx1151_08b_transfer_audit.reason: Dense H5120 already uses sole Q5T16 SSM-out and T16/source-F16 projection routes; the 0.8B K1024 shapes do not match.
The 0.8B recurrence is 16 K heads/16 V heads; H5120 is 16/48 and already benefits from compact peer-wave Q/K ownership.
All qualified H5120 rank-2 Q4 weights already use the sole Q4T16 representation and production bulk policies.

gfx1151_08b_transfer_audit.package: D3 fused dense gate/up plus SiLU
gfx1151_08b_transfer_audit.reason: The pack8 t128 leaf is shape-specific, but the existing Q4T16 dense dual local32+SiLU sibling exactly matches H5120 c1 and needs only policy admission.
The 0.8B pack8/dense-BF16 bodies do not consume H5120's sole Q4T16/qmicro-planar c1 owners; a new exact body and current profile would be required.
It is qualified only for 8Q/2KV/D256 at live 514-641; H5120 is 24Q/4KV/D256 and already selects the long-context parallel reducer at 32K.
The fixed hidden-1024 wave schedule does not match hidden 5120.

gfx1151_08b_transfer_audit.package: X2a/K1/K5 pack8 and dense-BF16 bulk WMMA
gfx1151_08b_transfer_audit.reason: H5120 has neither a resident pack8 Q4 payload nor expanded dense-BF16 FFN owners; sole T16 plus selected source-F16/rocBLAS routes already own bulk prefill.

limitations: The direct A/B uses separate resident processes in control-then-candidate order; each side has three low-variance measured runs.
Natural25 MTP has one full-suite run per route, as required by the dense suite protocol; every category is non-regressive in absolute MTP throughput.
Only the existing c1 gate/up+SiLU owner is retained. No 0.8B shape-specific pack8, GDN, attention, norm, or dense-BF16 policy is copied.
